items.title: Bioliberty raises €2.95 million to bring its AI-powered rehabilitation technology into the home
items.summary: Bioliberty, an Edinburgh- and Boston-based rehabilitation technology startup, has raised a €2.95 million ($3.3 million) Series A extension, bringing its total funding to €12.07 million ($13.5 million). items.title: The EIC confirms €1.8 billion for startups in 2027, with expanded defence and women-led startup support
items.summary: The European Commission has adopted the 2027 European Innovation Council (EIC) Work Programme, allocating €1.8 billion to support DeepTech startups, scale-ups and researchers across Europe. The funding package aims to help promising technologies move from early-stage research to commercialisation, while improving access to investment for women-led and DefenceTech companies.
